name: The White Tower of Horus
wayupText: The gem is yours. Stone grinds beside you: the slab has slid off the shaft in the top of the tower.
notes: Built by tools/make_nut.py. Change that file and run it again, rather than editing this one. Format: see levels/test.json.
You go UP here: the gem of Horus is at the top of the tower, among the clouds.
sky: this level is outdoors (see src/sky.js). ceilTex 'sky' = open to the sky: no roof is drawn, and nothing at the level's edge.
cap: a room under solid stone; its top, at the height 'cap', is ground you walk on above. slide: a slope too smooth to stand on.
beams: rays of stone to walk on, ladders: climb them (src/beams.js). lifts with dx/dz also move sideways and carry you.
fallDamage: falls of more than 6 m hurt, 16 m or more kills.

wallTex white = white stone carved with hieroglyphs (the rooms); towerEye / towerWings / towerNut = the tiers' outer walls (base, middle, top), smooth white marble written in gold hieroglyphs (src/towerart.js). floorTex whiteplain = plain white stone; sand = desert sand.
windows: long stained glass windows set in the tiers' faces (src/beams.js).

terrain: the dunes (src/terrain.js): heights at the corners of the cells; 0 = no dune there. shafts: light down the holes in the roof of the passage you come in by (src/beams.js). dark (a cell): under the ground, the sun does not reach it; underWall / underFloor / underCeil = its stone.
people: Sayed Rashid the trader, shut in a cell on the top until its lever is pulled (src/people.js, data/people.json).

spots.text: The way back to the hall.
Daylight. Dunes of sand as high as hills, and far off across them a white tower. Its top is lost in the clouds.
A passage of old stone under the ground. It is dark and cold, and it runs north.
Daylight falls through a hole in the roof ahead.
A long stair of stone climbs toward the daylight.
A great door at the foot of the tower. It does not move. A stair winds up round the outside of the tower.
A small dark room under the stair. Sand has blown in.
Cold air comes through the west wall here.
The chute ends in a small room. A ladder goes back up.
The gem of Horus lies on a plinth at the top of the tower, among the clouds.
A square shaft goes down into the tower. A slab of stone lies over it.
Someone is shouting behind the bars of a small stone house.
A ruined gateway of sandstone stands in the dunes: tall columns, a lintel still across them, sand to its knees.
Another small room under the stair. Old blankets, and the ashes of a fire.
A strongroom inside the tower. Someone kept their gold up here.
A gate of grey stone in the tower wall, with a silver lock.
A still pool beside the flooded passage. There is air to breathe here.
A dry ledge at the north end of the pool.
The south end of the pool. The east wall sounds hollow.
A flooded nook. The east wall sounds hollow.
The stair runs into a great buttress of stone. This passage goes on inside the tower.
A guard room inside the tower. A stair goes up from the passage outside it.
Daylight ahead: the passage comes out on the stair again, beyond the buttress.
The stair outside ends in the air. A doorway leads into the tower.
A hall inside the tower. A stair goes up from its south-east corner.
A store room at the foot of a steep stair. Broken jars, and dust.
A small room off the passage. Its east side is open to the sky. It is a long way down.
A stair of white stone winds up round the outside of the tower.
Sand has drifted against the foot of the stair here, as if wind blows through it.
There is a thin crack in the stone at the foot of the stair here.
Stones float in the air to the north of the stair, one after another, a little higher each time.
Steps go down into the sand between two worn stones.
A small tomb under the dunes. Nobody has been in it for a long time.
A pit in the sand, walled with stone. A ladder goes down into the dark.
Two rooms cut under the dunes. Something has been sleeping in the further one.
Steps go down into the sand between two worn stones. The air that comes up is warm.
A long passage. Something at the far end spits fire down it. There are niches in the walls.
A hump of dark rock stands out of the sand. There is a low cave in its side.
A small cave. It smells of animals. There are gnawed bones on the floor.
Steps go down into the sand between two worn stones. There is nothing else for a long way round.
A hall under the dunes. Passages lead west, east and north.
A pit in the sand, walled with stone. A ladder goes down a long way into the dark.
A hall under the dunes. A passage to the west is lit by fire, now and then.

gates.text: A gate across the stair. The lock is a golden scarab.
A gate across the stair. The lock is a golden scarab.
A gate. The lock is a scarab of pale turquoise.
A gate into the tower. The lock is a scarab of silver.
A gate of bronze bars. It will not move. There is a lever on the wall beside it.
